TO HEIGHTEN YOUR SENSES,
WE CREATED A FEW OF OUR OWN.
Avoiding an accident in the first place is always the safest route. With the available
i-ACTIVSENSE® suite of safety features1, sophisticated safety innovations alert you to
hazards to help you avoid collisions—or lessen their impact. These features help
improve your visibility and awareness of the road and monitor the traffic conditions
around you. When needed, these innovations will even perform lane-keeping
adjustments and automatic braking1. i-ACTIVSENSE creates a more confident driving
experience so you can feel focused and engaged with every drive you take.
ADVANCED BLIND SPOT MONITORING2
REAR CROSS TRAFFIC ALERT2
360˚ VIEW MONITOR
LANE DEPARTURE WARNING SYSTEM
LANE-KEEP ASSIST
ADAPTIVE FRONT-LIGHTING SYSTEM
HIGH BEAM CONTROL
SMART CITY BRAKE SUPPORT2
ADVANCED SMART CITY BRAKE SUPPORT
SMART BRAKE SUPPORT
MAZDA RADAR CRUISE CONTROL WITH STOP & GO
TRAFFIC SIGN RECOGNITION SYSTEM
1 i-ACTIVSENSE safety features are not a substitute for safe and attentive driving. There are limitations to the range and detection of each safety feature. Additional information provided in
Specifications. Please see your Owner’s Manual for further details. 2 Standard feature.

SPECIFICATIONS
ENGINES
SKYACTIV®-G 2.5L DOHC 16-valve 4-cylinder with VVT (Sport with MT)
SKYACTIV-G 2.5L with Cylinder Deactivation (Sport with AT, Touring)
187 hp @ 6,000 rpm
186 lb-ft of torque @ 4,000 rpm
SKYACTIV-G 2.5T DOHC 4-cylinder Dynamic Pressure Turbo
(Grand Touring, Grand Touring Reserve and Signature)
250 hp @ 5,000 rpm (with 93 octane fuel)
227 hp @ 5,000 rpm (with 87 octane fuel)
310 lb-ft of torque @ 2,000 rpm
TRANSMISSIONS & DRIVETRAIN
SKYACTIV-MT 6-speed manual transmission (Sport only)
SKYACTIV-Drive 6-speed automatic with manual shift and Sport modes
SKYACTIV-VEHICLE DYNAMICS with G-Vectoring Control
Hill Launch Assist1
FUEL ECONOMY
EPA-ESTIMATED MPG (City/Highway)2
24 / 33 (MT, Sport)
26 / 35 (AT, Sport and Touring)
23 / 31 (AT, Grand Touring, Grand Touring Reserve and Signature)
FUEL CAPACITY
16.4 U.S. gallons
DIMENSIONS
Overall length: 192.7"
Wheelbase: 111.4"
Width: 72.4"
Height: 57.1"
TRUNK CAPACITY
14.7 cubic feet
1 Hill Launch Assist is an auxiliary device that assists the driver in accelerating from a stop while on a slope. It is not a substitute for safe and attentive driving. There are limitations
to the system. Please see your Owner’s Manual for further details. 2 EPA-estimated mileage. Actual results will vary.

Thank you for considering a Mazda.
As you can see from the stories in this brochure, everyone at Mazda, including our Mazda Dealer
partners, is deeply passionate about creating cars that provide a memorable driving experience. This
passion all starts with you. Before the first sketch of a Mazda, before any new idea is conceived, we
consider you, the driver, first. All with the hope that you will feel our passion for driving once you’re
behind the wheel.
If you haven’t already experienced the excitement of driving a Mazda for yourself, schedule a test
drive at your local Mazda Dealer. Together, we will ensure that a great test drive is just the first step
in the joy of owning a Mazda.
Sincerely,
Masahiro Moro
President and CEO
Mazda North American Operations
